title: Hmongic languages - Wikipedia
text: Hmong is the biggest subgroup within the Hmongic peoples. Many overseas Hmong prefer the name Hmong, and claim that Meo (a Southeast Asian language change from Miao) is both inaccurate and pejorative, though it is generally considered neutral by the Miao community in China.

title: Sinicized Miao Language (HMZ)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Sinicized Miao is a stable indigenous language of China. It belongs to the Hmong-Mien language family and is part of the Hmong macrolanguage. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community.
